Package fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.es.events

Events for event scheduling DEVS simulation models.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    ES_EventI
    The interface ES_EventI defines the behaviours of events in the event scheduling view DEVS implementation of traditional discrete event simulation models.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ES_Event
    The class ES_Event defines the baseline implementation of an event in event scheduling simulation models which does nothing when executed on a model and returns an empty set of generated new events.
    EventComparator<E extends ES_EventI>
    The class EventComparator implements a comparison between events used to define a total order of execution among events.

This package implements generic events for DEVS simulation models adopting the event scheduling world view. Compared to standard events, these events provide methods to create events that are generated from their execution and to execute the event on atomic event scheduling models to change their state.
